key_concepts: Ovaries release one egg cell about every 28 days.
Fertilization in humans occurs in the fallopian tube.
Testes produce sperm; the urethra carries urine and semen.
Menstruation is the monthly shedding of the endometrium when no pregnancy occurs.
Animals reproduce sexually or asexually to continue their species.
Frogs use external fertilization and amplexus; butterflies use internal fertilization.
Flowering plants have female parts such as stigma, style, ovary, and ovule.
Pollination moves pollen from anther to stigma, often with help from insects or wind.
Plants may grow from seeds, spores, or bulbs and can be herbs, shrubs, monocots, or dicots
Estuaries mix fresh and salt water, filter pollutants, and serve as marine nurseries.
Intertidal zone organisms adapt by burrowing or anchoring to avoid being carried away by t
Pollution, overfishing, and trampling damage estuaries and intertidal zones.
